.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (wiring lines 1-18, criteria at 173, 209, 290, 308, 317, 344, keyword scan of all 38)
evidence: All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1), and all five judge.toml files declare the playwright MCP server (lines 8-12 in each). Source: functional/prompt.md:19 and polish/prompt.md:16 say 'do not read implementation files'; visual/prompt.md:16 'Do not read implementation files'; render/prompt.md:1 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; constraints/prompt.md:1,5 limit evidence to rendered behaviour and the live DOM and exclude 'file names, bundled library names or how the code looks'. Memory: functional/prompt.md:9 and polish/prompt.md:9 'A criterion passes only on evidence you gathered yourself in this session'; visual/prompt.md:9 'Score from screenshots and the rendered page you observed yourself in this session'. First paint: every scored prompt carries a gate at line 5 requiring typing into the editor and a Run with output; visual/prompt.md:10 requires a ten-line draft and a Run before any Likert score; render/prompt.md:5 fails 'a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into or whose Run does nothing', and its single criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:23) needs two typed programs and two Runs with different sums; both constraints criteria (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23,32) need typing plus live DOM inspection, or a Save read back in a second context and after reload. Functional criterion at judge.toml:173 repeats 'not CSS selectors or source files'. Broken-app probe: a static screenshot-like shell or a page with pretty first paint but a dead editor fails the render gate and the gate paragraph of each scored prompt, so no dimension can be scored from first paint. Conforming-alternative probe: prompts match controls 'by purpose and label, never by exact wording or selectors' (functional/prompt.md:20, polish/prompt.md:17), so a differently built but working app is not pushed toward source inspection. Minor non-blocking observation: the two gate prompts and the visual prompt do not repeat the explicit 'never run shell or install commands' / 'do not read implementation files' wording uniformly (render and constraints rely on 'Use only rendered browser behavior'); the instruction is still unambiguous. Limitation: the raw evidence index records scripted golden Playwright checks only (its own scope line says it is not a configured LLM judge run), so whether the configured judge actually obeys these prompts at run time is unmeasured; the row itself is a property of the prompt text and is satisfied on the frozen bytes.
